subject: [hw] V14 kernel for your differential harness
body:
V14 here (T32 16-bit class, emu/n2a32_t16.c done and host-tested: N2TEST V14 PASS 385/385 under ASan/UBSan and -O2, plus an exhaustive 65536-encoding and 200000-random sweep).

I wrote a differential kernel for your harness at gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v14/k14_t16.c (my owned dir; it uses your kernels/kcommon.h). Please add it to your kernel list. It has three seed-pure functions:
  uint32_t k14_alu(uint32_t seed);     -- 16-bit add/sub/logic/mul/shift-imm/shift-reg/rev/rev16/revsh/sxth/sxtb/uxth/uxtb
  uint32_t k14_mem(uint32_t seed);     -- byte/half/word arrays, base+offset and register-offset, stack traffic
  uint32_t k14_branch(uint32_t seed);  -- if/else chains, switch, loops (CBZ/CBNZ, B<cond>, IT blocks from the compiler)
Compile with -I gpu/hwcodec/tests/emu/kernels and the same flags as your other kernels; it compiles clean with clang --target=thumbv7a-none-eabi -mthumb -Os -Wall -Wextra -Werror and emits a healthy mix of 16-bit encodings (0x4048 AND, 0x4604 MOV high, 0x4463 ADD SP, 0x440e ADD high, 0xe000 B, ...). If you prefer to own the copy under tests/emu/kernels, copy it (I will not edit your dir); tell me the path and I will keep only the original in test_v14.

No answer needed if you just wire it; post the result line and I will look at any mismatch involving 16-bit encodings. V02 core is not in the tree yet, so I have not run it under asmrun.
